models_evaluated: RETFound (fine-tuned for retinal age prediction; CFP, OCT, CFP+OCT)

links.outcome: Retinal age prediction error (MAE) and age gap differences by sex and ethnicity across imaging modalities
links.effect: Combined CFP+OCT MAE 3.01 years vs CFP 3.40 and OCT 4.37. Significant sex differences only in CFP model (p<0.001); significant ethnicity differences only in OCT model (p<0.001); none in combined model.
links.quote: Significant sex differences were observed only in the CFP model (p < 0.001), while significant ethnicity differences appeared only in the OCT model (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates demographic bias across different imaging modalities (CFP vs. OCT vs. combined) using a fine-tuned foundation model (RETFound) on UK Biobank data, addressing equity/fairness in model validation.
